action.connect_here: Connect to the fastest server here

notice.ipv6: IPv6 changed — reconnect to apply it.

error.no_cli: proton-vpn-cli not found. Install it, or correct the CLI path in the plugin settings.
error.no_nmcli: nmcli not found. Proton VPN's CLI needs NetworkManager.
error.nmcli: Could not read the active NetworkManager connections.
error.no_servers: No server list cached yet. Run 'protonvpn signin' in a terminal so the CLI downloads one.
error.no_terminal: Could not open a terminal. Run 'protonvpn signin' yourself.
error.launch: Could not launch the Proton VPN CLI.
error.generic: The Proton VPN CLI reported an error.

cli_path.label: CLI path
cli_path.description: Command or absolute path for proton-vpn-cli.

poll_interval.label: Status interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often the active NetworkManager connections are read. This is an nmcli call, not a CLI call.

servers_refresh.label: Server list interval (minutes)
servers_refresh.description: How often the cached server list and the map are rebuilt. They also rebuild whenever the server, the theme mode or a colour changes.

color_server.label: Server dot colour
color_server.description: Colour of the city dots on the map.

color_connected.label: Connected colour
color_connected.description: Colour of the connected marker, the bar glyph and the location markers.
